summary: The wifi-bluetooth group is the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth stack of a device with a Qualcomm QCA6490 combo chipset (QCA6490 appears in the Bluetooth patch build strings and in the cnss-qca6490 sysfs node named in the SELinux file contexts). Vendor HAL services expose IWifi (HIDL 1.0 through 1.5), ISupplicant (1.0 through 1.4), IHostapd (1.0 through 1.3) and IBluetoothHci (1.0). These are backed by wpa_supplicant and hostapd 2.10-devel-12 daemons, Qualcomm WLAN services cnss-daemon and cnss_diag, and Qualcomm Bluetooth rampatch and NVM blobs stored as single-record TLV containers. The system partition holds the wificond daemon, the Bluetooth stack libbluetooth.so with its JNI library, the Wi-Fi APEX com.android.wifi (framework-wifi.jar, service-wifi.jar, ServiceWifiResources.apk), and privileged-permission and feature-flag XML. An Oculus vendor Wi-Fi HAL (vendor.oculus.hardware.wifi@1.0) is on odm, and a telemetry daemon is on system_ext. Configuration is delivered as wpa_supplicant and driver override text files, an ICM channel config, a Bluetooth stack trace config and Device ID files.

claims.corrected_claim: libwifi-system-iface.so exports android::wifi_system::InterfaceTool methods for interface up and down state (GetUpState, SetUpState, SetWifiUpState), MAC address set (SetMacAddress) and factory MAC lookup (GetFactoryMacAddress), and bridge create, delete, add and remove (createBridge, deleteBridge, addIfaceToBridge, removeIfaceFromBridge). libbluetooth_jni.so registers com.android.bluetooth native methods through android::register_com_android_bluetooth_* functions (for example sdp, hearing_aid and a2dp).
